title: Fathers and Sons
author: Ivan Turgenev
blurb: 19th-century Russian literature embarrasses itself yet again: three different girls in this book all have the exact same timid, blushing, bashful archetype, even down to identical reused descriptors. Must the visual novel medium continue to suffer such blatant licentious pandering?
blurb2: 20 - 12 = 29 - 18 17 + 3 = 23 Authors and dubious age-math. Many such cases!
